title: Would You Switch Doors?
hook:
Three doors. One car.
Would you *switch*?

challenge.explanation: Your pick wins 1 in 3. The host's reveal moves the other 2 in 3 onto the last door.

beats.narration: Three doors. One car. You pick one.
The host, who knows, opens a goat door. Do you switch?
beats.text: The host opens a *goat* door. Switch?

beats.narration: Switch. It wins two times out of three.
Your first pick only wins one time in three.

sources.claim: Switching wins with probability 2/3 when the host always opens a goat door
sources.ref: Selvin, S. (1975). A problem in probability. The American Statistician 29(1):67

post.caption: Stay or switch? Under the standard rules (the host always opens a goat door), switching wins 2 out of 3 times.
